newsitem.title: USA: Boyd Bros sees Q2 shr increase.
newsitem.headline: Boyd Bros sees Q2 shr increase.

text.p: Boyd Bros Transportation Inc said Monday it expects to report net income of between $0.17 and $0.19 per share for the second quarter ending June 30, which would exceed the analyst estimate for the period of $0.15 per share.
Donald Johnston, Boyd's president and chief executive officer, said the earnings expectations for the quarter reflect strong revenue growth, improved equipment utilization and better expense control.
"Throughout 1997, we have placed increased emphasis on improving the utilization of our trucks and generating higher revenue per truck," he said.
In the second quarter of 1996, Boyd reported operating revenues of $16,349,678 and net income of $307,033, or $0.08 per share.

Boyd provides transportation services to high-volume, time-sensitive customers, primarily in the steel and building materials industries, and operates throughout the eastern two-thirds of the United States.
